evidence_set: As summarized: 49 people with moderate ecstasy use against 50 people who did not use it; serotonin transporter binding lower in every region of the cerebral cortex (range -19% to -46%) and in the hippocampus (-21%), related to the extent of use (years, maximum dose); recent use confirmed by hair analysis, with other psychoactive drug use, sex, a gene polymorphism and chronic tolerance monitored; the review adds that studies of heavier use also found subcortical reductions (Kish et al., 2010).
